positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Testing and Tools, DevOps
- Designed, documented, implemented, and supported complex tools used by developers
and testers to interface with devices, coordinate lab equipment, and perform simulations
in an automated fashion.
- Took ownership of and fixed existing Gen 2 regression tests, eliminating false negatives.
- Reduced feedback time on introduced errors - introduced automated tests on code
merges.
- Assisted in manual testing for system software releases.
- Worked with manufacturing team to improve Gen 2 diagnostic tests, increasing coverage,
eliminating bugs, and reducing time to ship.
- Designed, implemented, and trained personnel in usage of Gen 3 hardware diagnostic
framework.
- Updated and developed new features for Django interface used for tracking, reservation,
and configuration of site-wide lab equipment.
- Helped to provision and deploy new devices for lab and field testing use by implementing
Ansible playbooks and training employees on usage.
- Trained new hires on existing systems and best practices, and performed code reviews.
- Conducted interviews for hiring candidates.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ownership of the Dailymotion Exchange (DMX) Ads Manager, a new platform that would enable the Sales and Content teams to add, remove, or edit ad source connections and inventory rules that determine which display and video ads are shown.
- Determined requirements for UI and functionality by meeting with stakeholders.
- Developed HTML and AngularJS UI that would allow non-technical personnel to manage ads.
- Customized Python-Eve to serve the project requirements. Python-Eve was used as the REST layer allowing the Ads Manager to access a Mongo database used for storage.
- Contributed towards Go-Liverail, an API allowing communication with LiveRail. (https://github.com/dailymotion/go-liverail)
- Created additional functionality for DMX-API, software that coordinates deployment of ad source connections, and advertising rules between the DMX stack LiveRail, and the web servers.

Developed features for DMX-bridge, a Go server deployed to each web server that enables the player to quickly receive an ad decision.

Helped to address advertising-related bugs and feature requests on the Dailymotion website.

Assisted in code reviews.

Languages used: AngularJS, Go, HTML, PHP, Python.

positions.description: See above (Dailymotion - Full Stack Software Engineer) for responsibilities.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed scripts using MATLAB, Python, and Verilog to streamline and improve verification process.

positions.title: Laboratory Research Assistant
positions.description: Synthesis and characterization of Ti0.7W0.3O2 using sol-gel techniques for catalyst support applications.
